_readme: Hand-verified endpoint coordinates. Keys are 'UTILITY:NORMALIZED NAME' (or 'STATE:NAME' / 'NAME'). 'endpoints' overrides how a project name is split into facilities. confidence: high = named substation matched in OSM/starter data; medium = named facility or road of that name in the right area; low = estimated from the project description.
